title: ENERGUN FM-1 CORE autonomous development infrastructure

workstreams.title: Repository-wide CI concurrency coordination
workstreams.implementation: A shared GitHub Actions concurrency-group prototype was tested on the fast and baseline workflows, but both runs were cancelled because GitHub concurrency groups retain only one pending run and workflows competed for that slot. The unsafe shared group was reverted; each workflow again has its own concurrency group.
workstreams.limitation: No cross-workflow lock is currently active. Implement a durable atomic lease/lock with owner/run identity, heartbeat/expiry, stale-lock recovery, guaranteed release and concurrency tests before enabling global coordination.

workstreams.title: Coding worker registry and capability model
acceptance: Worker identity, capabilities, availability and version are recorded
Workers have least-privilege repository permissions
No worker receives physical-device or main-branch write permissions

workstreams.title: Automatic task routing and assignment
acceptance: Task type and acceptance criteria select a qualified worker
Dependencies, concurrency budget and worker availability are enforced
Assignments and outcomes are auditable

workstreams.title: Isolated feature branches and workspaces
acceptance: Each coding task uses a dedicated branch/worktree
Branch base SHA and allowed paths are recorded
Concurrent workers cannot overwrite each other's changes

workstreams.title: Bounded autonomous source-code changes
acceptance: Worker receives a bounded task specification and file scope
Changes are diff-reviewed and do not touch protected paths
Worker cannot merge or access physical hardware

workstreams.title: Automated validation and evidence collection
acceptance: Relevant tests and target builds run on the exact task commit
Logs, artifacts, timing and exit status are retained
BLOCKED and FAIL are never converted into PASS

workstreams.title: Automatic reviewable pull request creation
acceptance: PR includes scope, diff summary, tests and evidence
PR targets an approved integration branch, never main by default
PR remains open for human review and is never auto-merged

workstreams.title: Independent review and quality gate
acceptance: Review is performed independently of the authoring worker
Required checks and evidence are verified
Unresolved review findings block promotion

workstreams.title: Conflict prevention, idempotency and recovery
acceptance: Task IDs and idempotency keys prevent duplicate execution
Stale leases and abandoned workspaces can be recovered safely
Conflicting PRs are detected before integration
